### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/scenarios`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via /:object/export (route, bridged from symbol templateMode — its route source's handler names it))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **1** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e1f09c33e8f464e340b2a01aa6e807ae598fad43` — the merge of head `89ea8b117537c20adec815f2004625523e16c4f0` into base `f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e1f09c33e8f464e340b2a01aa6e807ae598fad43 && git checkout e1f09c33e8f464e340b2a01aa6e807ae598fad43
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba 89ea8b117537c20adec815f2004625523e16c4f0 && git checkout -B drift-repro f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba && git merge --no-ff 89ea8b117537c20adec815f2004625523e16c4f0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景评测 template 模式的迭代后 Run 半程，遇到前一步写入改过的数据时，改在新起的副本上跑。副本是空白宿主，装入迭代后应用实际提供的元数据（先去掉读时装饰键），不再经应用接口写回。
- 为什么改：卡 #34497。写回会被应用自己的单向状态规则拒绝（asset_lifecycle 报废申请批准后不能退回），后续操作全记 NOT MEASURED。
- 风险与回滚：只改评测运行器（`@objectstack/scenarios`，已发布的 devx 工具，非协议），不影响产品运行时。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`orchestrate.ts` 的 `iteratedManifest` 与 `withInstalledBuild` 的 `copyOf`；测试里 #34497 的 template 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 34497`，1 条通过。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、160 行）。L1 意见：卡的三项要求都交付，前提有实测，两次消融都红，可落。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `89ea8b117537c20adec815f2004625523e16c4f0` · 2026-11-19T03:00Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 4 files, +116/−44, 4 commits (3 content + 1 main-only merge of `0c047d0c`, taken before the PR opened). `Fixes #34497` on the first content line; #34448, #34294, #35267 and ADR-0148 are named with no closing keyword beside them. `check-governed-merges --pr 35291`: 0 of 4 paths governed, 160 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no` holds: `iteratedManifest` is module-private, `withInstalledBuild`'s callback shape is internal, no export changes; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Fixes vs the card:** the card's gate (measure first, no write-back fallback) and its three asks are all met: (1) template mode's iterate Run half gets a `FreshCopy` that installs the served metadata; (2) the "without a fresh copy" case became the template-mode case measuring all six `asset_lifecycle` operations, with ablations; (3) the README bullet is updated. So `Fixes` is right.
- **Premise:** the dev measured it live on two `create-objectstack@18.6.0` hosts with no model (PR body, Readings): raw served items → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` on 3 flows (`_diagnostics`); after `stripReadDecorations` → 200, 11 collections alike, 0 field/validation/action differences, only `_packageId` differs (envelope, not item); seed 757/757 on both, `seedDifference` empty. L1 read the readings, did not re-run them.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34497-scenario-template-fresh-copy.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/scenarios` (published; no `private`). Sentences read against the diff: "Template mode still wrote the moved rows back … refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`" = the removed comment and the old pin; "a blank host booted from the same project with the iterated app installed unmanaged, the same way the run's own install landed" = `copyOf(iteratedManifest(manifest, served))` through `landed.install`; "each collection the app serves replaced by the items it serves after the iterate" = `iteratedManifest`, which also drops a collection served empty; "comes off its read decorations first (`stripReadDecorations` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`)" = the import and `items.map(stripReadDecorations)`; the measured-host sentences = the dev's live readings above; "carries `restored: { freshCopy }`" and "Door mode still writes the rows back" = `doorMode` calls `runHalf` with no `fresh`, pinned by the retitled #34294 case.
- **差异由 L1 读过:** the old `fresh` closure becomes `copyOf(installs)`, with `fresh = copyOf(landed.manifest)`, so scratch and ask copies are unchanged; template mode adds the iterated copy only. A managed fallback install stays managed on the copy, since `landed.install` is reused.
- **Pins:** the template-mode case runs `runCard` on `asset_lifecycle`: six of six operations measured and asked, `dispose_scrapped_asset` restored via `freshCopy: ['demoasset_disposal_request/dr06']`, zero rule refusals on any app, the iterated host took only its seed's writes, every copy installed the same objects as the iterated host (including the scripted iterate's object), every boot stopped. The `OneWayApp` double now serves `_diagnostics` and its install door refuses it, as the real door does. Ablations: no copy → 1 red (3 NOT MEASURED, write-back refused 400); strip removed → 1 red (5 NOT MEASURED, install refused 422); restored blob == HEAD both times.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `89ea8b11`: 33 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and Test Core among the successes). Dev local NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every dist), covered by CI's Lint on this head.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) The removed one-way write-back pin is not lost coverage: the write-back path stays pinned by the retitled #34294 case, which door mode uses. (2) A main-only merge commit without trailers. (3) The claim's ADR-0148 pointer was a keyword false hit (amendment 6998006254), so no ADR applies.
- **Nit, not blocking:** the 速读 line「只影响评测工具(私有评测包的运行器)」is wrong on one word: `@objectstack/scenarios` is published (`npx @objectstack/scenarios`). A body-only edit to「已发布的评测包」fixes it.
- **范围外去向:** none. The two Acceptance notes (an iterate adding a metadata type the template lacks is neither scored nor copied; agent-inserted rows are not carried to a copy) describe existing behaviour this PR leaves unchanged.
- **落地条款:** K = 8 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `0c047d0c` (< 15), no locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ai-1 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34497.
